title: Package - Metadata API
description: Specifies which metadata components to retrieve as part of a retrieve() call or defines a package of components.

members.description: One or more named components, or the wildcard character (*) to retrieve all metadata components of the type specified in the <name> element. To retrieve a standard object, specify it by name. For example, <members>Account</members> retrieves the standard Account object.

name.description: The type of metadata component to be retrieved. For example, <name>CustomObject</name> retrieves one or more custom objects as specified in the <members> element.
